acceptanceCriteria: Without --host, the target reports a repository-layer verdict and marks host as NOT_OBSERVED, with rc 0 when the repository layer is clean.
body: Found 2026-10-18 by the lane-hygiene lane (PR beamfall/corvint#1107, head b04b5b61d, ASD-V0-013..018). Expected: a usable repository-scoped verdict when no host layer is given. Actual: rc 2/3 with 'host layer not observed'.
title: `make instruction-conflicts` without --host returns UNKNOWN (host layer not observed) instead of a repository-only verdict
